_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.lead: Emoji has nothing to do with emotion
beats.note: From Japanese: e, picture, plus moji, character. That it sounds like 'emoticon' is an accident of English. The two words share no root at all.

beats.context: Shigetaka Kurita's 1999 set for DoCoMo, drawn on a grid of twelve pixels by twelve. The originals are now held by the Museum of Modern Art.

beats.lead: And 'the first emoji' is wrong too
beats.text: A rival set beat it by two years.
beats.note: SoftBank, then called J-Phone, shipped 90 emoji on a 1997 handset, before DoCoMo's 176. Kurita himself has said DoCoMo was not first.

beats.text: A word that is not about feelings, pinned to a set that was not first.

beats.line: The little pictures are older, and stranger, than the story about them.
